description: Full index of all data files in storage/data/

files.description: SQLite FTS5 full-text search database containing all knowledge base entries, team logs, scripts, and SOPs. Enables sub-millisecond keyword search across the entire repository with ranked results.

Unified benchmark dataset from 17 sources covering prototype performance (Proto A vs Proto B vs baseline), coordination overhead measurements, data-gathering method comparisons, and live deployment results. Contains 36 synthetic runs, 3 live tests, 2880 coordination measurements, and 146 data-gathering data points.

Empirical benchmark results from 7 test suites: team sizing (1-50 agents), SQLite contention (1-32 threads), thundering herd simulation, help offer races, pipeline throughput, connection pattern comparison, and tool correctness testing (45 tests). Contains 2000+ measurements per run.

Cross-analysis synthesizing 3247 data points from unified benchmarks, empirical benchmarks, think tank convergence results, and team analysis. Contains optimal team size recommendations (5-8 agents), power law efficiency model (E=4.0*N^-0.75), connection pattern verdicts, and infrastructure weak link priority map.

Level 1 compact meta-index of all repository entries across all resource types (KB, SCR, SOP, SRC, TEAM, TOOL). Each entry contains id, title, resource_type, category, and date. Designed for fast lookup without reading individual index files.
Level 0 summary of all resource types with entry counts, last update dates, and category lists. Provides a quick overview of repository contents without loading any full index.
